messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — Renewal for Nimbus Labs. They accepted the revised list price but want invoices split across two business units and Net45 payment terms. Procurement asked for a PO and vendor code. @nisha_revops can you advise on split invoicing and whether we can accept Net45?

nisha_revops: Quick Qs — are the two BUs under the same legal entity / tax ID? If same legal entity we can either: 1) issue two invoices to two billing contacts, or 2) create one invoice with two billed-to sections (less common). For Net45 we need finance signoff. Also need the PO number + billing emails.

sam_ae: Customer note (copied): "We need two invoices sent to billing@billing-nimbus.com and billing-eu@billing-nimbus.com, PO #PN-4983, and our procurement team requires Net45. We also want a single SSO e-sign flow for the amendment if possible." Attaching their email thread — forwarding to legal once amendment draft is ready.

akash_finance: Heads up — company policy is Net30 default. Net45 is allowed only with VP Finance approval for new terms. If we do split invoices we need two billing addresses and two tax IDs on file. Also need vendor onboarding (W9 or equivalent) before granting extended terms.

chris_legal: I can draft a short amendment that: (a) pins pricing and term, (b) specifies split invoicing instructions, and (c) updates payment term to Net45. Example header I plan to include:

```
Amendment No. 1 to Subscription Agreement between Redwood Inference and Nimbus Labs
Effective Date: <date>
Purpose: Add split invoicing and adjust payment terms to Net45 as set out in Exhibit A.
```

Will loop in billing contact in sign order.

maria_cs: Timeline constraint — Nimbus needs this in place before quarter close (next Fri). Can legal expedite? :hourglass_flowing_sand: Also we need Docusign flow that CCs procurement and finance for records.

docusign-bot: Envelope created by chris_legal: https://docusign.example/envelope/0xabc — status: draft, signers: finance -> billing -> procurement.

sam_ae: Please add billing@billing-nimbus.com and procurement@procure-nimbus.com as recipients and set signing order: 1) akash_finance, 2) billing contacts (both), 3) procurement rep. Also we need the invoice split config in the amendment (line items mapped to each BU).

nisha_revops: Workaround we've used before: issue two invoices (Invoice-A and Invoice-B) tied to one master subscription. Create an amendment that lists Invoice-A items and Invoice-B items, then attach both invoice PDFs post-signature. Checklist I will own:
- confirm tax IDs for both BUs
- collect PO + onboarding docs
- map PO to invoice numbers
- trigger invoice generation after signature

akash_finance: Conditional OK — I can pre-approve Net45 on a provisional basis if ARR >= $120k and vendor onboarding completes before signature. Otherwise I need VP sign-off. Please confirm ARR and expected first invoice amount.

maria_cs: ARR = $142,000, first invoice ~ $28,400 (split 60/40). I'll upload the PO and contacts to the thread when I have them. Thanks team — prioritizing this for EOD legal draft.
